WindowConf.title: Window configuration
WindowConf.tagDescription: Identification tag used to distinguish multiple floating windows
WindowConf.descriptionDescription: A brief description of the window function and purpose for list preview and quick identification
WindowConf.contentTypeDescription: The type of content displayed in the window (HTML or native View)
WindowConf.windowTypeDescription: The display type of the window (floating window, system window or dialog box)
WindowConf.htmlConfDescription: Configuration information when contentType is HTML
WindowConf.dialogWindowConfDescription: Configuration information when windowType is Dialog
WindowConf.floatWindowConfDescription: Configuration information when windowType is Float
WindowConf.systemWindowConfDescription: Configuration information when windowType is System
WindowConf.windowIdDescription: Unique identifier for the window, either ULID or UUID
WindowConf.forceDismissWindowTimeDescription: The countdown time (milliseconds) for the forced closing of the window. The default is 0, which means it will not close automatically. If it is greater than 0, it will automatically count down and close.

ContentType.title: content type enum
ContentType.description: Define the type of content displayed in the window
ContentType.ViewDescription: Use Android native View as window content (not currently provided)

WindowType.title: Window type enum
WindowType.description: Define the display level and behavior of windows in the system
WindowType.FloatDescription: Floating windows can be displayed above the application or globally, suitable for gadgets, timers, etc.
WindowType.SystemDescription: System-level windows have the highest priority
WindowType.DialogDescription: Dialog window, usually used to display prompts, confirmations and other interactions

HtmlConf.title: HTML configuration
HtmlConf.description: Configure the HTML content loaded by WebView and its parameters
HtmlConf.contentDescription: Enter the content URL or HTML code, the system will automatically identify and assign the value to the corresponding attribute
HtmlConf.contentPlaceholder:
Enter a URL (such as https://example.com) or HTML code (such as

title

)
HtmlConf.contentHelper: The system will automatically determine whether the input content is URL or HTML, and store it in the corresponding attribute
HtmlConf.contentInvalid: The input is neither a valid URL nor a valid HTML code
HtmlConf.urlDescription: The web URL of the HTML page to load
HtmlConf.htmlDescription: Direct HTML string content, or alternatively URL
HtmlConf.jsBridgeNameDescription: The name of the JavaScript object injected into WebView, used for JS to communicate with Native. Use the default name 'Android' if not set
HtmlConf.webViewJsParamsDescription: Parameter configuration passed by WebView to JavaScript
HtmlConf.webViewJsNameDescription: The name of the injected WebView JS object. Optional values: WebViewJs (normal JS call), AutoWebViewJs (can call Android script parsing). Default value is 'AutoWebViewJs'
HtmlConf.javaRunnerIdDescription: ID associated with JavaRunner on Android, used for script execution
HtmlConf.extraDescription: Additional extended configuration parameters, passed to the HTML page in JSON format
HtmlConf.extraPlaceholder: Enter the configuration in JSON format, for example: {"key": "value"}
HtmlConf.extraHelper: HTML pages can obtain this configuration by calling ${jsBridgeName}.onJsCallFun("extraConf", "")

WebViewJsParams.title: WebView JS parameters
WebViewJsParams.description: WebView passes parameters to JavaScript and obtains content configuration
WebViewJsParams.fitContentWidthDescription: The behavior of setting the width of WebView: -200 means automatically matching the screen width, 0 means automatically matching the content width, and when it is greater than 0, use the specific value (pixels)
WebViewJsParams.fitContentHeightDescription: The behavior of setting the height of WebView, the value rules are the same as fitContentWidth
WebViewJsParams.javaToJsDataString: Data passed from Java to JS
WebViewJsParams.javaToJsDataStringDescription: The data string passed from Java to JavaScript, JS can actively call the WebView method to obtain it
WebViewJsParams.fitContentIdDescription: HTML element ID selector for matching content width and height (used when fitContentWidth/Height is 0)
WebViewJsParams.fitContentClassDescription: HTML element Class selector used to match content width and height (used when fitContentWidth/Height is 0)
WebViewJsParams.fitContentJsDescription: Customize JavaScript script to match content width and height (security to be confirmed)

WebViewConf.title: WebView rendering configuration
WebViewConf.description: Rendering and display related configuration of WebView
WebViewConf.backgroundColorDescription: The background color value of the WebView, which is used when the HTML content is transparent.
WebViewConf.uaDescription: Custom User Agent string used by WebView when loading the page

FloatConf.title: Floating window configuration
FloatConf.description: Control the position, size, interaction and animation of floating windows
FloatConf.positionSaveNameDescription: The key name used to save the position of the floating window, allowing the window position to be restored after restarting. Support dynamic variables such as '${appName}'
FloatConf.draggableDescription: Whether the user can move the floating window by dragging it with his finger
FloatConf.defaultXDescription: The default X coordinate (pixels) when the floating window is first displayed, with the upper left corner of the screen as the origin
FloatConf.defaultYDescription: The default Y coordinate (pixels) when the floating window is first displayed, with the upper left corner of the screen as the origin
FloatConf.resetXDescription: Overwrites the saved X coordinate and repositions the window to that X coordinate value. Use saved value or default value when empty
FloatConf.resetYDescription: Overwrites the saved Y coordinate and repositions the window to that Y coordinate value. Use saved value or default value when empty
FloatConf.tagDescription: Unique identification tag used to distinguish multiple floating windows
FloatConf.sidePatternDescription: The behavior of floating window welt adsorption (15 modes are optional), including no welt, automatic welt, drag to end welt, etc.
FloatConf.showPatternDescription: The display range of the floating window: only the current Activity, always displayed, or only displayed in the foreground
FloatConf.hasEditTextDescription: Whether the content of the floating window contains editable EditText components (affects input method display)
FloatConf.gravityDescription: The alignment and coordinate offset of the floating window in the parent container
FloatConf.layoutChangedGravityDescription: When the window layout size changes, readjust the position alignment of the overall View
FloatConf.borderDescription: The boundary value that limits the dragging range (distance from the surrounding screen, unit: pixels)
FloatConf.matchParentDescription: Set whether the width and height of the floating window automatically fills the parent layout (setting match_parent directly in XML is invalid)

GravityInfo.title: gravity alignment information
GravityInfo.description: Specify the alignment direction and coordinate offset of the floating window
GravityInfo.gravityDescription: Use the Gravity enumeration value to specify the alignment direction of the window in the container
GravityInfo.offsetXDescription: Additional offset in the X-axis direction after alignment (pixels), positive values ​​offset to the right
GravityInfo.offsetYDescription: Additional offset in the Y-axis direction after alignment (pixels), positive values ​​offset downward

BorderInfo.title: Border restriction information
BorderInfo.description: Define the four-sided boundaries of the dragging activity range of the floating window
BorderInfo.leftDescription: The distance in pixels between the left border and the left side of the screen. The window cannot be dragged out of this range.
BorderInfo.topDescription: The distance in pixels between the upper border and the top of the screen. The window cannot be dragged out of this range.
BorderInfo.rightDescription: The distance in pixels between the right border and the left side of the screen. The window cannot be dragged out of this range.
BorderInfo.bottomDescription: The distance in pixels between the lower border and the top of the screen. The window cannot be dragged out of this range.

MatchParentInfo.title: Full of layout information
MatchParentInfo.description: Control whether the floating window automatically fills the width and height of the parent layout
MatchParentInfo.widthMatchDescription: When set to true, the width of the floating window automatically fills the width of the parent layout
MatchParentInfo.heightMatchDescription: When set to true, the height of the floating window automatically fills the height of the parent layout

Gravity.title: gravity alignment enum
Gravity.description: Define the alignment and position of objects in the container
Gravity.LEFTDescription: Align to left edge of container
Gravity.RIGHTDescription: Align to the right edge of the container (END is recommended to support RTL layout)
Gravity.ENDDescription: Aligned to the end of the container (LTR layout is right, RTL layout is left), recommended for international applications
Gravity.STARTDescription: Align to the beginning of the container (LTR layout is left, RTL layout is right), recommended for international applications
Gravity.CENTERDescription: In the center of the container (centered both horizontally and vertically)

FloatShowPattern.title: Floating window display mode enumeration
FloatShowPattern.description: Define the visible range and display conditions of the floating window
FloatShowPattern.CURRENT_ACTIVITYDescription: The floating window is only displayed in the current activity and will be hidden when switching to other applications.
FloatShowPattern.ALL_TIMEDescription: The floating window is displayed globally and continues to appear even if you switch to other applications or lock the screen (requires system permissions)
FloatShowPattern.FOREGROUNDDescription: The floating window only displays when the app is in the foreground

FloatSidePattern.title: Floating window edge mode enumeration
FloatSidePattern.description: Define 15 behavior modes of floating window dragging and edge adsorption
FloatSidePattern.DEFAULTDescription: In the default mode, the floating window follows the movement of the finger and does not automatically adhere to the edges.
FloatSidePattern.LEFTDescription: The floating window is fixed to the left side of the screen and can only be moved up and down on the left edge.
FloatSidePattern.RIGHTDescription: The floating window is fixed to the right side of the screen and can only be moved up and down on the right edge.
FloatSidePattern.TOPDescription: The floating window is fixed to the top of the screen and can only be moved left and right at the top edge.
FloatSidePattern.BOTTOMDescription: The floating window is fixed to the bottom of the screen and can only be moved left and right at the bottom edge.
FloatSidePattern.AUTO_HORIZONTALDescription: Depending on the distance between the finger and the left and right edges of the screen, it will automatically choose to stick to the left or right side.
FloatSidePattern.AUTO_VERTICALDescription: Depending on the distance between the finger and the upper and lower edges of the screen, it will automatically choose to stick to the upper or lower edge.
FloatSidePattern.AUTO_SIDEDescription: Automatically select the closest edge welt based on the distance between your finger and the four edges.
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_LEFT: Drag and paste to the left
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_LEFTDescription: It moves with your finger when dragging, and automatically sticks to the left edge when you release it.
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_RIGHT: Drag and paste to the right
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_RIGHTDescription: It moves with your finger when dragging, and automatically sticks to the right edge when you release it.
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_TOPDescription: It moves with your finger when dragging, and automatically sticks to the top edge when you release it.
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_BOTTOM: Drag and paste to the bottom
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_BOTTOMDescription: It moves with your finger when dragging, and automatically sticks to the bottom edge when you release it.
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_HORIZONTALDescription: Follow your finger when dragging, and automatically stick to the left or right edge when you release.
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_VERTICALDescription: Follow your finger when dragging, and automatically stick to the top or bottom edge when you release it.
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_SIDE: Drag and paste to the four sides
FloatSidePattern.RESULT_SIDEDescription: Follow your finger when dragging, and automatically stick to the nearest edge when you release.

FloatWindowConf.title: Floating window window configuration
FloatWindowConf.description: Comprehensive overall floating window configuration, including floating window behavior and front-end service settings
FloatWindowConf.floatConfDescription: Detailed configuration of the floating window (position, size, interaction, etc.)
FloatWindowConf.foregroundTextDescription: Prompt text for foreground service notification. After setting this, the system will create a foreground service message in the message bar when the floating window is opened. When the floating window blocks the close button or an exception occurs, the floating window will be closed through the message in the message bar. It is recommended to fill in.

DialogWindowConf.title: Dialog window configuration
DialogWindowConf.themeDescription: Theme resources used by the dialog box

SysWindowConf.title: System window configuration
SysWindowConf.viewLayoutParamsDescription: Layout parameter configuration of system window View
SysWindowConf.listenBackKeyDescription: Whether to intercept the system return key event. If true, the system return key will be intercepted.

WindowConfPreview.title: Window configuration preview
WindowConfPreview.description: Used to quickly preview window configuration information in the list
WindowConfPreview.detailEditDescription: Open the full edit page for detailed configuration
